articles.title: Wang defeats Zhang for tennis gold at Asian Games
articles.excerpt: Wang Xiyu defeated Zhang Shuai 6-2, 6-1 to win women's singles tennis gold on Friday at the Asian Games. The victory also gave her an automatic berth at the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles.

articles.title: WTA to offer equal prize money at Italian Open, other big events in 2027
articles.excerpt: The Italian Open will offer women the same amount of total prize money as men in 2027 as part of a "major milestone" initiative from the WTA Tour.

articles.title: More top-level events to award equal prize money in 'major milestone'
articles.excerpt: The Women's Tennis Association confirms all its combined 1000 events will award equal prize money from 2027 in a "major milestone".

articles.title: Nishikori's career ends with Japan Open loss to Tiafoe
articles.excerpt: Kei Nishikori had an emotional farewell to his tennis career, playing his final match at the Japan Open in a 6-4, 6-4 loss to Frances Tiafoe.

articles.title: GB's Kartal wins on WTA return after six months out
articles.excerpt: Britain's Sonay Kartal wins on her return to the WTA Tour after six months out with injury as she beats Andrea Lazaro Garcia at the China Open.

articles.title: Eala denied by Wang, settles for Asian Games bronze again
articles.excerpt: Alex Eala will have to settle for bronze once again at the 20th Asian Games after losing to Wang Xiyu in the semis on Thursday.

articles.title: 'I kept fighting right to the end' - emotional Nishikori retires
articles.excerpt: A tearful Kei Nishikori says he "kept fighting right to the end" as the former world number four ends his professional career at the Japan Open.

articles.title: Navarro taking break to deal with health issues, plans return at Aussie Open
articles.excerpt: Emma Navarro says she's taking the rest of the tennis season off to address two health issues and plans to return ahead of the Australian Open in January.

articles.title: Alex Eala secures Asian Games medal with quarterfinal triumph
articles.excerpt: Alex Eala is through to the semifinals at the Asian Games and is now guaranteed at least a bronze medal.

articles.title: Navarro opens up on health struggles that caused 'deep anger' on court
articles.excerpt: American Emma Navarro says she has gained her "life back" as she shares her long-running health problems that caused significant weight loss, fatigue, dizziness and left her "feeling deep internal anger" on the court.

articles.title: Djokovic wins first match since Wimbledon at China Open
articles.excerpt: Novak Djokovic beats Nuno Borges at the China Open to secure his first win since reaching the Wimbledon semi-finals in July.

articles.title: Despite medical timeout, Djokovic starts China Open with win
articles.excerpt: Novak Djokovic maintained his flawless record at the China Open despite needing a medical timeout during his first round match on Wednesday.

articles.title: Eala 'didn't take lightly' decision to play Asian Games over China Open
articles.excerpt: Alex Eala is prioritizing representing the Philippines at the Asian Games over the WTA Tour for the moment -- even if that means risking a fine.

articles.title: Eala rolls past Patcharin to reach Asian Games quarterfinals
articles.excerpt: Alex Eala's Asian Games is off to a winning start after she cruised past Patchari Cheapchandej on Monday.

articles.title: Zverev tops American Tien to clinch Laver Cup for Team Europe
articles.excerpt: Alexander Zverev clinched the decisive points that brought the Laver Cup back to Team Europe.

articles.title: Wimbledon finalists Noskova, Muchova secure BJK Cup for Czechia
articles.excerpt: In July, they played each other in the Wimbledon final. Now, Linda Noskova and Karolina Muchova have teamed together to win the Billie Jean King Cup for Czechia.

articles.title: Zverev comeback leads Europe to Laver Cup victory
articles.excerpt: Alexander Zverev recovers from his day two defeat by Alex de Minaur to beat Learner Tien and clinch the Laver Cup title for Team Europe on the final day.

articles.title: Czechs beat Ukraine for 12th Billie Jean King Cup title
articles.excerpt: The Czech Republic ease past Ukraine to win the Billie Jean King Cup for the 12th time thanks to wins for 2026 Wimbledon finalists Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova.

articles.title: Alcaraz helps Europe to 3-1 Laver Cup lead after opening day
articles.excerpt: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over Team World on Friday's opening day of the Laver Cup after Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik sealed the final point with a doubles victory in London.

articles.title: Alcaraz wins after saving match points as Europe lead Laver Cup
articles.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz narrowly avoids back-to-back singles defeats for the first time in 18 months as Team Europe lead Team World at the Laver Cup.
